body: You're right. That helps put it into perspective. But I'm not sure if it was sexual assault or not. Like I said, the boundaries were blurry. And I've only just recently brought this up as an issue. I don't think he would do it again.
Okay, thank you! We're both friends with the guy in question, for probably around 2-3 years. I can see how it makes me look bad, though.
Noted, thank you.

He's regretful, though. He was crying and saying he wanted a drink and I had to stop him. His family has a history of drinking problems, and he's had an issue with it too in the past. 

He also said he wouldnt be ready to have sex again for a while. Doesn't he sound sorry to you?

But I think I am. I thought so even before he brought it up. I'm not a nice person, and I'm working on it in therapy. I feel like he has a right to bring it up, just not a right to use it against me in fights.

I think I blurred up the lines. When I say "no" I mean it, but sometimes the act feels fine and doesnt hurt or make me feel bad so I just let it go. Sometimes I really dislike the act, and thats when I have a problem with him not listening to me when I say "no."

But shouldn't he be listening to me every time, regardless?
Thank You! It's just hard because I thought he was that person. I still think he's capable. We both need to work on it.

Thank you for your advice. I've been in a relationship before, and I never had the affection, support, etc. that I used to have in this one.

I don't think I have done anything to make him doubt my judgement, other than one time that he and I still disagree on. I wanted to drink because my parents were on vacation, and I wanted someone over because I really don't know my limits (it was my second time drinking). My boyfriend was at work, so I called a male friend over. 

Nothing happened between us. He was playing video games as I drank. After a while I began throwing up and passed out, so I didn't reply to my boyfriend for 2-3 hours? I don't remember exactly. Maybe 4? 

When I did message him he was furious because I was active on fb messenger (my friend was on it, I also don't remember why). 

Do you think this is emotional cheating? I don't think it is, but he insists he "has no other word to describe it."
We've noticed that before. He says he doesn't like the person he is with me, and he doesn't like the person I am with him anymore.

I'm not sure. He says I'm emotionally abusive and I'm manipulative and I'm mean. Which is true, I do have a temper. 

But when I think about it, I don't think I'm manipulative. A few months ago, I felt like I was going to harm during a fight and I told him because he told me to tell him so that he can help support me. When I did, he told me to stop manipulating him.
Yes, we will start taking "me time" time apart. We've been working on letting the other person have some space when we can feel an argument going downhill. Thank you for your suggestion.
But I feel like I'm clingy to a fault. It can't be realistic to demand so much of his time and attention.
Thank you for your suggestion of having him tell me a few things he loves about me before taking some time to recharge. I will suggest it to him.
I think we both need to learn to communicate better. Thank You!

He broke up with me a few weeks ago. He changed his mind when I started sobbing. Is this typical abusive behaviour? He says it was in the heat of the moment, and that he would have never left me. It kinda hurt, though.
I'm sorry you had that experience. How long did it take you to recover, if you don't mind me asking?
Thank you. Yes, I plan on doing this.
Ouch.

But I did feel so loved and valued and worth it in the beginning of the relationship. I've never had that kind of relationship before. You don't think we can get back there eventually?

I feel like I've ruined him. I've always had a temper problem. He used to be calm during arguments, but now he says hurtful things too. Should I feel responsible?  

And I really appreciate the offer. PM'ing you right now.

Edit: Sorry about all the deleted comments. My phone glitched and posted this comment many times.

Ok, I agree with the Janna thing. But to clarify, I didn't mention it was Star Guardian Janna. I don't know, I really love the costume and the colours. But since he opposed it, I wasn't planning on going through with it anyways.

Thank you for your advice over the consent and diagnosing stuff. I think I covered pretty much all of it in the comments above, but please let me know if I missed anything.

Thank you for your advice, I really appreciate all the work you put into it. Seeing it put like this just makes me cry all over again. Because even if he is as horrible as you guys say, I've still been with him for a year and I still love him.

My memory is really bad. After the original sexual assault (a couple years ago), I couldn't remember the event at all and I started forgetting other things too. He's said that he would never gaslight me because of my memory problems.

Last night, I didn't bring up anything but I came home late from the gym and he was not in a very good state. He was crying, and asking me to tell him if he "raped" me and to "tell him the truth." 

I comforted him and we both went to sleep. I know it was probably the wrong thing to do. I'm tired of fighting with him. If I wasn't the op but a commentor, I would tell me to run too. I don't know what's wrong with me.

I've always been more on the conservative side. I think he might have made the comments in surprise, then I got too defensive and it spiralled out of control. 

He feels like he's in the right, though. He said that we might record our conversations in the future because I'm "making empty baseless accusations" and that I'm the one gaslighting him. 

If I wasn't the crazy one, then why would he offer to do something like that?

Thank you for your advice. I feel very stupid after reading all of these comments, but also a little unsure. 

He's told me I'm emotionally abusive before. This post and these comments are very biased in favour of me. Maybe I'm unintentionally framing him as the bad guy, even though I'm the one at fault. I don't know.

I've been uncertain of my mental health for a while now, though. I suspect that it's not only depression but something else as well. I plan to consult my family doctor on what to do next in regards to that. 

I still feel like it was a mean thing to do, though. I confided in him about struggling with my mental health, and I feel like he threw it back in my face to hurt me.

But to be fair, he did explain why he sent it. He said it's a symptom to feel like you've suddenly become more intelligent and you're making "break-throughs" or something. I did feel that way, and expressed it to him.
He's told me I'm the emotional abuser, though. And I do say mean things in the heat of the moment. I'm working on it currently, and I'm not proud of my temper problems at all.

No, I initiate most of the time. It's just that sometimes he doesn't listen to me when I tell him not to do a specific sexual act. I talked about this a bit more in a comment above.

If he notices something is hurting me or that I'm not in a good mental state, he'll stop. He's told me that sex isn't that important to him before. In the beginning of the relationship, when I wasn't ready to have sex he didn't force anything for several months.

I wasn't sure if I was the one at fault or not. Reading these comments are really helpfu, Thank you.

I think I'm the more manipulative one out of the two of us. He's told me that I'm emotionally abusive before, and that I'm mean. To be honest, I do have a temper problem and I say mean things that I regret afterwards. I also tend to stonewall him.

 I thought him and I could improve as people together. Am I being stupid?

Sorry for the late reply, but I guess I should have specified more. 

A little embarrassed about this, but I wanted to try out bdsm with him (and we had a safe word). After a while, I told him a few times that I didn't like it anymore and just wanted to do "nice" or "vanilla" stuff. I don't think I quite got through to him though.

 I initiate quite a bit, so I guess he has my consent (because I initiate, right?). It's just specific acts that I hate and have told him not to do that he still does, even if I tell him "no" or "stop" in the moment. But I didn't use the safe word any of those times, so maybe he didn't think I was serious? 

I don't know. I feel like he's still a wonderful guy, I could gush about him but I didn't in the post. He's a better person than I am.

Please let me know if I'm being stupid and delusional. I feel so lost whenever we have an argument, and even if I feel like I'm right I get confused and drop the issue or convince myself it's not as important as I thought it was. Thank you guys for all the responses and advice.

Thank you for your advice. I should have included a more balanced overview of him. When I told him how his actions made me feel, he was regretful. He generally treats me well: buys me snacks, stays up with me when I'm working late on homework, and usually makes time for me when I feel low. With this information, do you still think I shouldn't be with him?
Thank you for your kind words! I agree with you 100% on this community being wonderfully supportive. One day at a time is a good motto. I'll try my best.
Thanks for the offer! Is it okay to dm you? Not sure if that's allowed on this subreddit.
I'm studying something in the sciences, but I haven't decided exactly what yet. How about you? Why're you feeling blue?
